summary_1line: Rama rebuts Javali’s materialist advice, defending Vedic authority, truth, and his duty to honor his father’s vow and remain in exile.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama stands calm in the forest before the sage Javali, raising his hand as he solemnly declares that truth upholds the world.
Rama, with resolute expression beside Sita and Lakshmana, proclaims he will honor his father’s vow and remain in exile despite the offered kingdom.
